_: THE CATALOGUE. Each pattern is an instructional situation with named slots and a small set of APPROVED SUBDESIGNS. A subdesign is selected by the SURFACE and — only where a pattern declares `aspects` — the media's own aspect class. There is no third input, and no rule anywhere may consult content. `areas` is grid-template-areas verbatim: the CSS is generated from this file, so the design and the layout cannot drift apart the way a grammar in prose once drifted from thresholds in a script.

notes.basic.intent: Prose-led teaching notes with no primary visual — the default page of a lesson.

slots.name: intro
slots.rationale: What this page is about, in the author's voice, before any detail.

slots.name: reading
slots.rationale: The explanation itself. A table of values belongs to the explanation, not to a separate data track.

slots.name: support
slots.rationale: A rule stated once and set apart. Set NARROWER than the prose so it reads as subordinate — the grid is what makes that legible rather than arbitrary.

slots.name: synthesis
slots.rationale: What the page adds up to. Absent on a page that is purely expository.

reading reading reading reading reading reading reading reading . . . .
support support support support support support . . . . . .
synthesis synthesis synthesis synthesis synthesis synthesis synthesis synthesis . . . .
subdesigns.notes: ONE COLUMN AT THE MEASURE, and that is the right answer for a page of prose. The four unused columns are READING MARGIN, not an empty track: nothing is named there and nothing promises content. The support slot is deliberately six columns so a key idea reads as an aside rather than as another paragraph.

notes.basic.adversarialContent: One paragraph of 250 words, and a nineteen-column table of values inside the reading slot.
notes.basic.residueRisk: A support RAIL beside the reading column would be residue whenever the aside is short. There is no rail: support sits in the flow, narrower.

slots.name: support

slots.name: examples
slots.rationale: Sibling examples. They are EQUIVALENT — the same move on different numbers — which is the one situation GOV.UK's guidance says tabs suit.

slots.name: synthesis

visual.explanation.intent: One primary visual and the reading of it, where the READING carries the teaching. The plane never crosses the reading measure; a page where the plane itself is the point is `media.full`.

slots.name: media
slots.rationale: THE SLOT GIVES THE WIDTH. The plane renders faithfully inside it at equal unit scale and its height follows from the authored domain.

slots.name: interpretation
slots.rationale: The reading OF the visual. Mayer's spatial-contiguity principle is why it is in this pattern at all rather than further down a generic page.

slots.name: support
slots.rationale: What the visual establishes, stated once.

subdesigns.selectedWhen: the desktop surface — this pattern's plane never crosses the reading measure, whatever its shape

subdesigns.notes: The plane takes the full measure and the reading sits beneath it at the same width, so the two share both edges and read as one object. EIGHT COLUMNS AT EVERY ASPECT CLASS: a page whose plane should cross the measure is `media.full`, and choosing between the two is the AUTHOR'S decision about what the page is for — not a shape the renderer noticed. A taller page is the deliberate outcome, not a failure.

visual.explanation.readingMeasure: interpretation is 466px in `side` and 760px in `stacked` — both inside the measure, and both a grid position rather than a chosen number.
visual.explanation.mediaSlotBehaviour: The media slot's column span IS the figure's width — eight columns, the measure, at every aspect class. The figure is never asked how large it would like to be and the pattern never widens a slot to suit it.
visual.explanation.adversarialContent: A four-sentence interpretation against a nine-paragraph one, at both aspects — the prescribed subdesign and every slot width must be identical.
visual.explanation.residueRisk: A SIDE-BY-SIDE SUBDESIGN WAS DESIGNED, RENDERED, MEASURED AND REMOVED. Seven columns of plane beside five of reading fills the surface exactly and looks right when the reading runs to four paragraphs; with a one-sentence reading it left roughly 600px of empty column — the same rail this project has now rejected three times. A composition whose soundness depends on HOW MUCH PROSE THE AUTHOR HAPPENED TO WRITE is content-dependent, and content is exactly what may never decide a composition. So every visual pattern in this catalogue stacks its media and its reading, and the aspect class chooses only how wide the plane is.

slots.rationale: COMPARISON IS THE POINT, so neither case may ever be behind a tab.

slots.name: caseB
slots.rationale: The second case, at identical width — equal treatment is the argument the composition makes.

slots.name: media
slots.rationale: One visual belonging to both cases. Directly beneath them, adjacent to both.

slots.name: interpretation
slots.rationale: The reading of the shared visual.

slots.name: synthesis
slots.rationale: What the comparison establishes.

visual.compare.readingMeasure: Cases at 564px (desktop) and 407px (tablet); prose slots at the measure.
visual.compare.mediaSlotBehaviour: As visual.explanation. The shared plane's aspect selects between the two desktop subdesigns.
visual.compare.adversarialContent: Case A with two steps against Case B with seven — the two slots must stay identical in width and the row must not reflow.
visual.compare.residueRisk: Unequal case heights leave the shorter case's column open beneath it. That is a ROW's leftover, not a named track promising content; the slot's own box ends with its content. The shared plane never spans only part of a case, which would claim it belongs to one of them.

media.full.intent: A single media object IS the page — a wide graph, a diagram, a recorded explanation — with its reading beneath. THE ONE PATTERN WHOSE PLANE CROSSES THE READING MEASURE, which is what distinguishes it from visual.explanation: there the reading teaches, here the object does.

slots.name: media
slots.rationale: The reason the page exists. It is the one slot in the catalogue permitted to cross the reading measure, because it carries no prose.

slots.name: interpretation
slots.rationale: The reading of it, immediately beneath — inset to the measure, so the media's edges and the prose's edges are deliberately different.

slots.name: support
slots.rationale: What the object establishes.

media.full.readingMeasure: The media is exempt because it holds no prose. Everything else is measure-bound.
media.full.mediaSlotBehaviour: The full subdesign hands the media the entire grid. That is the only place in the catalogue where a slot crosses the measure, and it is why the pattern declares aspect classes rather than accepting any figure.
media.full.adversarialContent: The same page with a portrait plane instead of a wide one — the pattern must take its inset subdesign rather than producing a 1400px-tall figure.
media.full.residueRisk: A 12-column media row leaves nothing beside it, so there is no track to be empty. The risk is the opposite one — a plane too tall for the width — and the aspect classes are what answer it.

interactive.primary.intent: A manipulable object is the page: an opening brief, the workspace, and prompts directing what to try.

slots.name: intro
slots.rationale: What the object is and what changing it does. Read once, before touching anything.

slots.name: workspace
slots.rationale: The object and its controls as ONE slot: a control detached from what it controls is the spatial-contiguity failure in its purest form.

slots.name: prompts
slots.rationale: What to try. Beside the workspace on desktop so the learner reads and acts without leaving either.

slots.name: synthesis
slots.rationale: What the exploration was for.

subdesigns.notes: The prompts sit beside the workspace, not beneath it: a learner who has to scroll away from the object to read what to try has been given two tasks instead of one.

interactive.primary.readingMeasure: intro, prompts and synthesis are measure-bound. The workspace is not: it holds no prose.
interactive.primary.mediaSlotBehaviour: The plane inside the workspace takes the workspace slot's width, exactly as a media slot. The controls sit under it at the same width so the two read as one instrument.
interactive.primary.adversarialContent: Eleven prompts against two — the workspace must not change width, and the prompts column must not push the object narrower.
interactive.primary.residueRisk: A tall workspace beside a short prompt list leaves the prompt column open beneath. The prompts slot ends with its content; nothing paints an empty track.

practice.workbook.intent: A question set beside a persistent writing pad — the stimulus stays while the worklist moves.

slots.name: intro
slots.rationale: What this set is for. Spans the page above both columns.

slots.name: questions
slots.rationale: THE ONE SLOT IN THE CATALOGUE THAT OWNS A LOCAL VERTICAL SCROLL, and only because the pad beside it must stay put. This is a template feature, never a way of making teaching content shorter.

slots.name: workspace
slots.rationale: Where the learner writes. THE SHEET IS A WINDOW AND THE PAPER SCROLLS INSIDE IT — more paper never means smaller writing.

questions questions questions questions questions workspace workspace workspace workspace workspace workspace workspace
subdesigns.notes: FIVE AND SEVEN. The questions are short and the writing is not, so the pad takes the larger share — the reverse of what a resolver balancing areas would have produced.

practice.workbook.readingMeasure: questions at 466px (desktop) and 407px (tablet) — inside the measure at both.
practice.workbook.mediaSlotBehaviour: None; the pad is a workspace, not media.
practice.workbook.adversarialContent: Twenty-two questions against four — the pad must not move, shrink, or change its rule spacing, and the question pane must not widen.
practice.workbook.residueRisk: A short question list in a bounded pane leaves the pane's bottom empty. That is why the pane is `max-height` and not `height`: it collapses to its content and the emptiness never appears.

slots.rationale: Grid paper. ITS SQUARES ARE SQUARE, because the mathematics the learner is about to draw is — the same equal-unit rule the figure engine obeys, applied to the surface the learner draws on.
